notablePrerequisites: Your life total is greater than an opponent's.
description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Spear Spewer enters the battlefield, triggering Obsidian Battle-Axe, attaching it to Spear Spewer and giving it haste.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Spear Spewer, adding {R}.
Koll triggers, returning Spear Spewer from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat until all opponents with a lower life total than your own have lost the game.
